polly_player.bin (I710ar): the Polly Tracker C64 player, 1086 bytes = a 124-byte RSID v2 header followed by the 962 bytes at $0801
(load address $0801 plus the 6502 player code), the first 0x7C + 962 bytes of HVSC/DEMOS/UNKNOWN/Polly_Rock.sid
(md5 of the whole HVSC file bfe033969b4a5d1374cfe788904f10af, title "Polly Rock", 2005).

Origin: Polly Tracker by Aleksi Eeben (2005). Its module-to-SID tool makes a tune of this player followed by the module as saved; the players in the
four HVSC tunes made so differ only in byte 43 (the high byte of where the module ends), which the Selecta sid plugin sets per song. The same
approach is bbmp's (github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp, src/bbmp/backends/polly.py, GPL-3.0-or-later), which downloads this file from HVSC at run time.

Licence: none stated by the author. Johan decided 2026-11-08 to vendor the player bytes in the repository (scene files free to use, project policy);
the 962 bytes are 6502 machine code, not C++ or Python source, and are not linked into any binary as code: they are data that the sid plugin
(GPL-2) copies in front of a Polly module and hands to libsidplayfp. The header's name/author/released texts are overwritten per song.
Remove on request of the author.
